mapper.sql: select t.id, t.name, t.sort, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, t.province_id, t.cover_image, t.description, t.latitude, t.longitude, t.view_count, p.name as province_name, p.country_id, co.name as country_name from voya_ai_city t left join voya_ai_province p on p.id = t.province_id left join voya_ai_country co on co.id = p.country_id
mapper.select:
where t.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and co.del_flag = '0' and co.status = '0'
and (t.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by t.sort desc, t.id desc
select * from voya_ai_city where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
select count(*) from voya_ai_city where name = #{name} and province_id = #{provinceId} and id != #{id}

select (select count(*) from voya_ai_attraction where city_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0') + (select count(*) from voya_ai_guide where city_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0') + (select count(*) from voya_ai_trip where city_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0')
mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_city (name, sort, status, remark, province_id, cover_image, description, latitude, longitude, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values (#{name}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{provinceId}, #{coverImage}, #{description}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), '0')
mapper.update: update voya_ai_city set name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, province_id = #{provinceId}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, description = #{description}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_city set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_city set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{username}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
